description: The account's published posts as they are on the platforms, including posts made outside oriiion, with captions, platforms, media type and metrics. By default the best performers by engagement: study these to learn what content resonates and create more of what works. With sort 'recent' the newest first: use that for 'what's our latest post' or 'can you see my videos/feed'. mediaType 'video' is a video post (on Instagram a Reel or a feed video); a 'carousel' can hold videos too.

days.description: Look-back window in days. Default 30, or 365 with sort 'recent' — omit it when asking for the latest posts

sort.description: 'engagement' for the best performers, 'recent' for the newest posts first
